definitions.explanation: A wide sash worn around the waist to secure a kimono.
A strip or band wrapped around something.

examples.japanese: {着物|きもの}に{帯|おび}を{締|し}める。
examples.english: To tie an obi around a kimono.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}の{帯|おび}を{借|か}りた。
{本|ほん}に{帯|おび}が{付|つ}いている。
examples.english: The book has a promotional band.

notes:
{帯|おび} primarily refers to the traditional sash worn with kimono, but also has broader meanings.

KIMONO USAGE:
- {帯|おび}を{締|し}める (to tie an obi)
- {帯|おび}を{結|むす}ぶ (to tie/knot an obi)
- {帯|おび}{締|じ}め (obi fastener)

TYPES OF OBI:
- {袋帯|ふくろおび} (formal double-folded obi)
- {名古屋帯|なごやおび} (Nagoya obi - semi-formal)
- {半幅帯|はんはばおび} (half-width obi - casual)

OTHER MEANINGS:
- {本|ほん}の{帯|おび} (book band - promotional strip)
- {周波数帯|しゅうはすうたい} (frequency band)

COUNTER:
- {本|ほん} for long items
